record.name: Threads
record.one_liner: The Threads API allows third-party developers to create and publish posts, retrieve media and profiles, moderate replies, and access insights using OAuth 2.0 and REST endpoints.

auth.notes: API authentication is handled by Threads user access tokens that conform to the OAuth 2.0 protocol (short-lived and long-lived tokens), or app access tokens using client credentials.

access.notes: Developers can create a Meta app and configure the Threads use case themselves in the App Dashboard, though some permissions and webhooks require App Review / Advanced Access.

api_surface.notes: Provides REST endpoints accessed via graph.threads.com or graph.threads.net, along with webhooks for real-time notifications.

buildability.reasoning: Self-serve credential generation is available via the App Dashboard, but going live or using specific permissions requires manual App Review / Advanced Access.
